name: IMO Prelim Past Paper
statement:
In a test, a question required students to draw a triangle in which the largest and the
smallest interior angles differ by $54^\circ$, and then compute the sum of any two of the
interior angles of the triangle drawn. The sums obtained by two students were $x^\circ$
and $y^\circ$ respectively. Find the greatest possible value of $x - y$ .
